entries.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
entries.summary: RRSI regularizes recursive harness evolution so an agent can keep improving prompts, control flow, tools, memory, and context management without simply overfitting its evolution suite; proposal budgets, exploration history, critics, cost-aware selection, and pruning improve held-out transfer while reducing policy-token use.

entries.title: Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents
entries.summary: AIDE² makes an AI research agent's own code the optimization target: proposed rewrites are benchmarked on hidden evaluations and accepted versions become the agent edited next. An autonomous eight-day run produced seven successive improvements that transferred to held-out AI R&D tasks.

entries.title: RegenHarness: A Robot Agent Harness with Evidence-Gated Recursive Self-Improvement
entries.summary: RegenHarness adds an evidence-gated RSI protocol to an embodied robot agent: execution records motivate changes to context rules, task templates, routing, and recovery policies, while regression checks, authorization, versioning, and rollback determine which harness changes become persistent.

entries.title: WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models
entries.summary: WaveFront Decoding exploits intermediate recurrence outputs as draft predictions and weight sharing to batch token states from different positions and recurrence depths, turning the sequential decoding cost of looped language models into a diagonal wavefront and substantially accelerating Ouro and Huginn models without retraining.

entries.title: Statistical Gains from Looped Estimation under Parameter Budgets
entries.summary: This theory paper formalizes when repeatedly applying one fitted operator can beat an untied stack under the same parameter budget, and shows that a specified post-layer-normalized looped Transformer can attain minimax rates with a fixed bounded parameter count by trading parameters for iterative computation.

entries.title: Nonequilibrium Phases of Repulsive Self-Attention: Chaos, Attention Condensation, and Emergent Locality
entries.summary: A minimal recurrent Transformer is analyzed as a dynamical system, revealing bifurcations, period-two motion, chaos, attention condensation, and emergent locality. The results sharpen the picture of what repeated self-attention can do when recurrence itself drives representation geometry.

entries.title: Brain-Inspired Hierarchical Modularity for General Continual Learning
entries.summary: This work adapts pretrained foundation models to uncertain online streams with hierarchical modularity: random expansion routes experience into specialized experts while diversified integration combines modules across spatial and temporal scales, separating conflicting experience while retaining useful transfer.

entries.title: Muon Can Outperform Dedicated Continual Learning Methods
entries.summary: For continual LoRA adaptation, Muon's orthogonalized updates spread learning across substantially more effective singular directions than AdamW. A plain incremental LoRA with Muon reaches or exceeds dedicated continual-learning baselines, suggesting optimizer geometry itself can provide a strong anti-forgetting mechanism.

entries.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
entries.summary: ACLArena studies capability retention across sequential agent post-training and proposes a continual-learning recipe combining replay of high-quality trajectories with a routed network of LoRA experts specialized by reinforcement learning, improving multi-domain reasoning and agentic capability integration.

entries.title: SPeaR: Test-Time Adaptation with Steering Primitives for Realigning Representations
entries.summary: SPeaR keeps the pretrained network frozen and learns lightweight steering primitives inside the model directly from the unlabeled test stream. Gated uncertainty reduction, diversity regularization, and multi-depth anchoring let Transformer representations adapt continually without source data or full parameter updates.

entries.title: Q-REACT: Test-Time Adaptation with Query-Dependent Residuals for Visual Document Retrieval
entries.summary: Q-REACT turns sparse reranker feedback into reusable test-time improvements by learning a shared low-rank transformation that generates query-dependent residuals while keeping encoders and the document index frozen, allowing adaptation to amortize across later queries and held-out tasks.

entries.title: EvoAudio: Recursive Self-Improvement for Audio Understanding
entries.summary: EvoAudio closes a persistent model-data loop: the current audio-language model's weaknesses determine the next questions and difficulty, tool-generated audio transformations provide verifiable supervision, reinforcement learning updates the model, and validation decides which model seeds the next evolution round.
